accessibility.name: Sign in or create an account

texts: Add what needs doing, set a due date, check it off when it's done. Your list stays yours and no one else sees it.
Sign in or create an account
New accounts start with 3 sample tasks.
Everything you add stays on one dashboard, with the numbers to match.
Type a task, pick a date, and it lands at the end of your list. One click marks it done in place, green with a check mark.
Switch between All, Pending and Completed. Each tab shows its count, so you always know what's left.
Statistics reads straight from your list: total tasks, completed and pending, with the share of the day behind you.
